notes: Research summaries describe study findings and limitations; do not extrapolate to efficacy of any specific audio/meditation program.

claims.claim: Original effect first named by Peter Thompson in 1980
claims.decision: Use title/year, do not republish original photograph.

claims.claim: Eye/mouth patches locally inverted inside globally inverted face
claims.decision: Discuss what was changed; no guarantees of effect.

claims.claim: Original Thatcher image is free for us to reproduce
claims.decision: Rights restricted; new vector art instead.

claims.claim: All visitors will fail to notice alterations when inverted
claims.decision: Never use all/everyone/no exceptions language.

claims.claim: 1993 examined three manipulation classes
claims.decision: Locally inverted, displaced and grotesque-expression comparisons.

claims.claim: Inversion uniformly reduces abnormality of all facial expressions
claims.decision: Avoid flattening conditions; grotesque expression differed.

claims.claim: Mouth interpretation can depend on other facial features
claims.decision: Scope to study's test conditions.

claims.claim: Thatcher effect proves a face-only specialized module
claims.decision: 2010 non-face effects show uniqueness claim unsupported.

claims.claim: Thatcher-like effects found with buildings/cars/bikes/letters in tested tasks
claims.decision: Do not say faces and objects are identical.

claims.claim: Configural processing switches off instantly at 180°
claims.decision: Rotation experiments suggest gradual effect.

claims.claim: Inverted faces slowed speeded local-feature judgments
claims.decision: Response time is task-specific, not mind-reading.

claims.claim: Negative photographic presentation hindered discrimination
claims.decision: Experiment-specific; do not imply medical effect.

claims.claim: Orientation effects were found for eyes or mouth displayed alone
claims.decision: Local-feature evidence complicates whole-only explanation.

claims.claim: One original cartoon portrait accurately reproduces experiment with known effect size
claims.decision: Explicitly label illustration not validated.

claims.claim: Observer's reaction measures intelligence, attention disorder or suggestibility
claims.decision: No diagnoses, scores, guarantees or universal responses.

claims.claim: Thatcher illusion establishes a particular historical eyewitness was mistaken
claims.decision: Methodological analogy only, no causal inference.

claims.claim: Zen12 seller describes 12-minute sessions and 12 program levels
claims.decision: Confirm exact product-specific page before promotion.

claims.claim: Zen12 12 minutes gives equal benefits to hour of regular meditation
claims.status: seller promise, NOT substantiated for product
claims.decision: Do not claim equivalence or time-saving efficacy.

claims.claim: Hypnosis Live Total Focus listing includes 33-min MP3
claims.decision: No personal-use testimonial or price.

claims.claim: Total Focus guarantees limitless powers of concentration
claims.decision: Exclude product effect from scientific article.

claims.claim: Brainwave Focus Shot includes 15- and 30-minute audios
claims.decision: Do not claim audio improves visual perception.

claims.claim: Focus Shot reliably produces 4+ hours of perfect focus
claims.decision: No efficacy transfer from perception research.

claims.claim: Brainwave Shots audio is universally without risks
claims.decision: FAQ warns about epilepsy and needing to remain awake.

claims.claim: Public Inspire3 affiliates page proves Final Vestige accepted for all offers
claims.decision: Account-specific acceptance, approved links and channel terms required.

claims.claim: FTC allows sole disclosure buried on another page
claims.status: not sufficient for reader-facing earning link
claims.decision: Near-link clear plain-language commission statement required.

claims.claim: Product claims may inherit general therapy research without product trials
claims.decision: Require competent and reliable relevant product-specific evidence.

claims.claim: Proposed /mind/thatcher-illusion/ URL is currently live
claims.decision: Don't link unpublished URL in active email or site.

claims.claim: Referrer URLs, identities and cross-site clicks are necessary for measurement
claims.decision: No raw referrer, fingerprints, persistent IDs; consent review first.
